title: A paid session-load record gives each arm's cost at 1, 4 and 8 Haiku 5.5 sessions
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a session-load record of paid Haiku 5.5 runs, arms A, C, D and the lean worker arm, phases idle and working, at 1, 4 and 8 sessions at once, 3 reps each, its spend under the cap the operator gave, and its table in kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'report', '--check'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('report --check', p.returncode, p.stdout[-400:])
rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv', encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
paid = [r for r in rows if 'haiku-5-5' in r['model']]
for arm in ('A', 'C', 'D', 'worker'):
    for case in ('idle all', 'working all', 'idle all x4', 'working all x4', 'idle all x8', 'working all x8'):
        assert [r for r in paid if r['arm'] == arm and r['case'] == case and r['metric'] == 'cpu_s' and r['runs'] == '3'], ('no 3-run paid row', arm, case)
spend = [float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['metric'] == 'spend_usd']
assert spend and max(spend) <= 4, ('no spend row, or a record spent over the $4 cap', spend)

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A,B', '--reps', '1',
                    '--window', '12', '--pane-every', '5', '--out', out], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
rows = [r for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
git_cpu = [r for r in rows if r['case'].endswith(' git') and r['metric'] == 'cpu_s']
assert git_cpu and all('parent' in r['note'] for r in git_cpu), 'a git cpu_s row does not say its CPU is charged to the hook that started it'
b_rows = [r for r in rows if r['arm'] == 'B' and r['metric'] in ('cpu_s', 'rss_peak_mb', 'rss_mean_mb')]
assert b_rows and all('window' in r['note'] for r in b_rows), 'an arm B cpu_s or rss row does not say it is over the pane window'
rec = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv', encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
for c in sorted({r['commit'] for r in rec}):
    q = subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', c, 'HEAD'], capture_output=True)
    assert q.returncode == 0, ('a session-load record row names a commit that is not on this branch', c)
